title: The Case of the Fifth Word
subject: English
summary: “The Case of the Fifth Word” is an interesting mystery story that involves a puzzle and the use of intelligence to solve it. The story takes the readers through a series of clues that create curiosity and suspense. The characters carefully observe the details, think logically and try to discover the hidden meaning behind the mystery. As the investigation continues, the truth is finally revealed through careful thinking and reasoning. The story teaches us that we should be observant, patient and use our intelligence to solve problems and mysteries.
